title: Origami hero flow and step accordion assets for compact quickstart
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design, produce, and hand off a compact ‘Origami’ hero and a paired step-accordion pattern for the Quickstart landing page. The goal is a space-efficient hero that communicates Redwood Inference’s core value (fast, predictable inference) with a kinetic fold/expand visual motif and an accessible, keyboard-friendly accordion for step-by-step onboarding. Deliverables include high-fidelity Figma frames (desktop / tablet / mobile), annotated screenshot masters for Docs, motion specs for the hero micro-animations, export-ready PNG/SVG assets for release notes, and a screenshot capture runbook for engineering QA.
acceptance_criteria: Hero compositions (desktop/tablet/mobile) approved by PM and engineering with final copy and CTAs
Figma frames contain export-ready artboards with component tokens and spacing guide
Step accordion states: collapsed, expanding, expanded, error state — all accessible via keyboard and screen reader annotations
Screenshot masters for Docs and Console matching pixel guidelines and 2x export for retina
Motion spec documented (duration/easing/triggers) and validated by frontend on staging implementation
Performance check: hero animation does not exceed 50ms jank budget on typical Dedicated demo machine
All assets uploaded to the release folder and linked in the PR; final sign-off by Design Lead and PM
tasks: Audit current quickstart hero variants and identify content to surface in compact layout (Avery)
Define fold/expand metaphor and sketch 3 distinct interaction concepts (Priya)
Create high-fidelity Figma frames for each concept and run internal critique (Design)
Prototype motion in Figmotion and export Lottie+CSS references for engineering
Design step-accordion component with 3 sample steps and edge-case states (error/timeout)
Write screenshot capture runbook + naming conventions for QA and docs team
Coordinate with frontend (Miguel Ortega) to validate token parity and responsive breakpoints
Prepare export-ready assets (SVG/PNG) and upload to release/assets/quickstart-origami-2026
Prepare annotated accessibility notes (aria attributes, focus order, keyboard shortcuts)
Collect PM sign-off and attach final Figma link to PR
